title: LogEntry
description: PROV-aligned provenance record stored on GeoJSON features. Target schema for validation — implementation will be generated from LinkML.

activityId.description: Unique operation identifier (UUID v4). Shared across features in multi-feature operations.

timestamp.description: When the operation occurred (ISO 8601 with timezone).

used.description: Feature IDs of inputs. May be empty for operations with no explicit inputs.

generated.description: Feature IDs or versioned asset paths of outputs. May be empty for in-place modifications.

executionDuration.description: Wall-clock execution time in ISO 8601 duration format (e.g., PT0.3S).

generatedResultId.description: Stable logical identity for artifact-producing tools (e.g., bt_plot_001). Null for non-artifact tools.

tune.description: Parameter tuning record. Null until a tuning operation modifies this entry.

WasGeneratedBy.description: Identifies the tool and its parameters for a specific invocation.

parameters.description: Full resolved parameter set. Keys are parameter names, values are ParameterValue objects.

ParameterValue.description: A typed parameter value with replay metadata.

default.description: Whether this is the default value.

tunable.description: Whether this parameter can be modified during replay.

parameter.description: Name of the parameter that was changed.
